sentences.text: On a chilly evening, Emperor Akbar and Birbal walked beside a lake.
Akbar wondered aloud, “Would anyone stay in this cold water all night for a reward?
A poor man nearby heard him and said he would try, because his family needed the money.
The man stood in the lake through the night.
In the morning Akbar learned that a distant lamp had helped him keep going.
Then the lamp warmed him,” the emperor said, and refused the reward.
Birbal left court and did not return for several days.
When Akbar visited, he found a pot of rice hanging high above a tiny fire.
It will never cook,” Akbar said.
Birbal replied, “If that faraway lamp can warm a lake, surely this little fire can cook rice up here.
Akbar smiled, understood the lesson, and gave the man his promised reward.
